method: Local compiled build on port 5180, without the Vite development websocket/reload client. Private headed Chromium on Xvfb. Connected through the public connectOverCDP noDefaults option so Playwright does not emulate all pages as focused/visible. Two actual tabs: document.hidden=true, real AudioContext suspended, automatic walk stopped; focus return resumes audio and preserves selections without automatically restarting the walk. Separate native CDP freeze/thaw for three seconds. No synthetic visibility event, hidden-property replacement or claim of OS sleep.
